notes.title: PAD Hotfix 7 - GLITCH FIXED IN DESCRIPTION
notes.content:
[b]If you have an AMD GPU, updating to the latest AMD update will cause serious problems![/b]
(25.8.1 = UNPLAYABLE)
 
[b]The fix is to simply go back one update on your AMD GPU![/b]

If you still have glitch errors lmk!

[list]
[*]also fixed treasure chests dropping nothing
[/list]

notes.title: PAD Hotfix 6
notes.content: Attempting to fix the gltichy stuff on starting up the game. if your stuff was broken and is now fixed, DM me on discord please please at battlebus01

notes.title: PAD Hotfix 5
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Ghost Crabs Die at the end of the Spectral Gem Fight
[*]You can skip the Dialog from the Pacifist Ending to save time

[*][b]Hints for the Pacifist Ending:[/b]

[*]The Stars are found in the space station
[*]Don't Overthink the Crab Claw
[*]The # for the Diamonds is found in the lobby before you start a multiplayer game
[*]Don't Overthink the Gem
[*]The UFO symbol is found at the start of the yellow gem fight. The # of that symbol is the # you input

[*][b]If you get stuck, JOIN the discord for help![/b]

[/list]

notes.title: Pair A Dice Pacifist Ending!!
notes.content: [h1]A Huge Update has been released, the Pacifist Ending![/h1][p][/p][p]It's all connected with the Safe that you can find underwater![/p][p][/p][p][b]Some Helpful Hints:[/b][/p][list][*][p]The Safe CAN'T be opened if you have killed any creatures, bosses, or have cheats on (You won't drown, just go straight there on a new playthrough)[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Make sure the Lobby Host is the one Entering the codes!!! (Server Host is the one who checks if the final code is correct)[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]For everyday the code cannot be cracked, I'll give a big hint for one of the numbers![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Also:[/p][p]**Fixed Achievements -If you didn't get the final Hidden Achievement, DM me on Discord[/p][p]**If the pacifist Update breaks anything, please let me know via the Bug Report or Discord :) [/p][p][/p][p]GOOD LUCK[/p]
